title: Equality of left fractions is equality after a common refinement
statement: Let C and D be categories, let W be a class of morphisms of C satisfying the left calculus-of-fractions axioms, and let L : C ⥤ D be a functor that inverts W and has the universal property of the localization at W [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let (f_1 : X ⟶ Y_1, s_1 : Y ⟶ Y_1) and (f_2 : X ⟶ Y_2, s_2 : Y ⟶ Y_2) be left fractions with s_1, s_2 in W. Then L.map f_1 ≫ inv (L.map s_1) = L.map f_2 ≫ inv (L.map s_2) if and only if there exist an object Z and morphisms t_1 : Y_1 ⟶ Z, t_2 : Y_2 ⟶ Z with s_1 ≫ t_1 = s_2 ≫ t_2, f_1 ≫ t_1 = f_2 ≫ t_2, and s_1 ≫ t_1 in W.
